items.value: Grandma, where did the passage to the second floor go? I wanted to rest.
Yeah, take a rest! You'll probably lock yourself in your room again! No point in messing around!
Just look! Everything's locked and relocked with a hundred locks!
Excuse me, could you please stop screaming so loudly? I'm trying to sleep.
Yes, ahem... my little cutie, come closer, I'll give you some more work.
Thank you very much, but I was wondering what I was missing?
Grandson, can you help me? The courier will be here soon...
Greet with bread and salt?
And kiss you on both cheeks, you wit. I ordered something delicious, as I knew you'd come!
It's even surprising. How could a clairvoyant know about this?
Shut up! Okay, run faster, the courier will be here soon.
Bite me, wasp, you whisper so loudly that it’s even worse than when you screamed!
Where is grandma?
I'm for her.
Wow, who did they send me here? Let me tell you a riddle, okay?
I don't like them.
Well then listen... In strong armor, a helmet on the head, But in the soul - fog, in the eyes - doubly sad.
Well, hare! Well, just you wait!
Oh, wow, you also have vision problems. I'm a rabbit, not a hare.
Now you'll turn into a real pig!
Okay, calm down, here's your product. Say hi to grandma for me.
Yeah, definitely.
You won't, umm, learn! I won't give you the pancakes! You won't pass!
First find a broom, then get the goods from the strange rabbit, and now this! RRR!!!
Oh, my, that really perked me up. It's a shame so few of them showed up.
Forgive me, grandson, I have a pixie blocker at home, I turned it off, I couldn’t help you right away
I survived - and thank goodness for that
So, are you feeling better yet? Occupational therapy is helping, huh? It cures everything, from depression to burnout. Personally, I've always worked because it ennobled me.
You know, I really do feel better! I think I should stay and “recover” a little longer. After all, I’m on vacation.
Now that's something! You're a good boy, my sweet little pie!
Thank you, granny
You're welcome! We'll wait for the others and try the pancakes, they're simply delicious! Come on, let's go to the table.
I'm tired, I'm going to bed.

Oh, those damned pixies! Were they trying to steal my pancakes? I see, though, that they didn't succeed. You're a smart girl, grandson, you can always be relied upon! I'll even give you a second helping for that.
Oh, those damn pixies! Were they trying to steal my pancakes? Oh, I see they took a few plates… good thing I made extra. I hope those fairies choke on it!

Oh, those damn pixies! Were they trying to steal my pancakes? Oh… They stole almost all the pancakes, there's only one plate left! Those damn gluttons, I hope they're all gone, I hope a meteorite falls on them! Oh well, at least there are some pancakes left.
